vignettes: Open templates folder. This command must be the first argument.

name: .where
description: Open crace root folder. This command must be the first argument.
vignettes: Open crace root folder. This command must be the first argument.

name: logDir
description: Directory where the results are from.
vignettes: Directory where the results are from. The default log directory is the current folder.\begin{xwarningbox}The execution directory must exist before executing [1mcplot[0m, it will not be created automatically.\end{xwarningbox}

name: outDir
description: Directory where the output files will be storaged.
vignettes: Directory where the cplot outputs will be storaged. The default output directory is the current folder. \begin{xwarningbox}This directory can be created automatically when executing [1mcplot[0m. \end{xwarningbox}

name: title
description: The title of the output plot which would be shown in plot.
vignettes: The title of the output plot which would be shown in plot. The default value of this option depends on the [4mlogDir[0m and the [4mdrawMethod[0m. This option is only avaliable when [4mlogDir[0m and [4mdrawMethod[0m are not None.

name: fileName
description: The name of the output plot file.
vignettes: The name of the output plot file. The default value of this option is [1mcurrent time[0m. This option is only avaliable when [4mlogDir[0m and [4mdrawMethod[0m are not None.

name: drawMethod
domain: (boxplot, violinplot, parallelcoord, parallelcat, sunburst, pairplot, histplot, jointplot, heatmap)
description: The type of plot for the crace results.
vignettes: The type of plot for the [1mCrace[0m results. If this option is not null, [4mlogDir[0m must to be provided. When one method is selected, the correspoding option must be True.

name: dataType
description: The origin of data used for drawing plot(s).
vignettes: The origin of the data used for drawing plot(s). [1mperformance[0m: the performance of configurations from experiment(s), the parameters of configuration(s) from one crace run and the performance of configurations from one crace run.

name: numConfigurations
description: The number of configurations used to draw plot.
vignettes:
The number of configurations used to draw plot: 
	elites: all elitist configurations selected in slice. 
	final: the final best configurations returned by crace. 
	all: all elite configurations selected in slice.

name: selConfigurations
description: The seleceted configurations used to draw plot.
vignettes: The selected of configurations used to draw plot, which is avaliable only when [1melse[0m is selected for [4mnumConfigurations[0m.

name: slice
description: Split slice based on the default or budgets.
vignettes:
Split [1mslice[0m based on the default that is related to model updating, or budget that could be the number of executions or runtime. 
By default, it's None, which means not to split the information when plotting.

name: split
description: Addtional option for [1mslice[0m.
vignettes: Addtional option used for [1mslice[0m. Use a list of integer values to select specific slices splited based on model updating, which is the default split method in crace, and a list of numbers to select specific slices splited based on budget. For the latter case, this list is used to partition the budget on a logarithmic scale.

name: source
description: The type of results from provided Crace, training or testing.
vignettes: The type of configurations from provided Crace results. \begin{itemize}\item[] [1mtest[0m: select configurations in the test part.\item[] [1mtraining[0m: select configurations in the training part.\end{itemize}

name: keyParameter
description: This parameter is selected to be the key variable when drawing parallelcoord, pairplot.
vignettes: This parameter is selected to be the key variable shown in plot [1mparallelcoord[0m or [1mpairplot[0m. For example: if one parameter is provided as the key variable for [1mparallelplot[0m, the plot will be grouped by this parameter.

name: multiParameters
description: Multiple parameters provided to draw plot like scatter matrix.
vignettes: Multiple parameters provided to draw plot like scatter matrix for the provided Crace results.

name: dpi
description: The parameter dpi used for saving plot.
vignettes: When method used to draw a plot will export a plot file, this parameter will be added to control the dpi quality of the exported plot.

name: showfliers
description: The parameter showfliers used for saving plot.
vignettes: Enable/disable showfliers when drawing the plot.

name: showmeans
description: The parameter showmeans used for saving plot.
vignettes: Enable/disable showmeans when drawing the plot.

name: showscale
description: The parameter showscale used for saving plot.
vignettes: Enable/disable showscale when drawing the plot especially for [1mparallelcoord[0m.

name: statisticalTest
description: Add p-values for plots or not.
vignettes: Enable/disable add p-values when drawing the plot.
